newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-RIEPER AND MOLNAR STRIKE FOR DENMARK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RIEPER AND MOLNAR STRIKE FOR DENMARK.

text.p: Denmark stayed on course for a place in the World Cup finals with a 2-0 European group one qualifying win over Bosnia on Sunday.
Some fine saves by goalkeeper Mirsad Dedic kept the Danes at bay until the 61st minute when Marc Rieper broke the deadlock.
Substitute Miklos Molnar sealed Denmark's win with a second goal in injury time.
Group leaders Denmark have 13 points from five games, three ahead of Greece who have played six. Croatia have nine points from five matches.
